headline: This law renames the Jefferson National Expansion Memorial in Missouri as the Gateway Arch National Park.
what_it_does: The bill gives the Jefferson National Expansion Memorial in Missouri a new name, Gateway Arch National Park. The summary does not describe any new funding, rules, or changes to how the site is run. It took effect when it was signed into law on February 22, 2018.
when_it_takes_effect: February 22, 2018, the date it was enacted.
